Separately autoclave concentrated Bacto Yeast Extract, coenzyme M, sodium acetate, Na 2 S·9H 2 O and FeS solution under a N 2 atmosphere in tightly closed vessels. Add the autoclaved concentrated solutions, and filter-sterile concentrated MgCl 2 ·6H 2 O, vitamin solution, trace element solution, methanol and sodium formate solution. After re-exchanging with N 2 , add 1 drop of filter-sterile 10% sodium dithionaite solution in 1 M NaHCO 3 by syringe. Final pH of the complete medium should be 9. *Mineral base 1 Na 2 CO 3 185 g NaHCO 3 35 g NaCl 16 g K 2 HPO 4 1 g Distilled water 1 L Mix ingredients and autoclave under a N 2 atmosphere. Because some precipitate appears on the bottom for 1 day after autoclaving, use only supernatant for making the medium. Final pH should be 10. **Mineral base 2 NaCl 240 g NH 4 Cl 0.5 g K 2 HPO 4 2.5 g KCl 5 g Distilled water 1 L Mix ingredients and autoclave under a N 2 atmosphere. Final pH should be 7.3. ***Vitamin solution Biotin 2 mg Folic acid 2 mg Pyridoxine-HCl 10 mg Thiamine-HCl 5 mg Riboflavin 5 mg Nicotinic acid 5 mg Ca-pantothenate 5 mg p -Aminobenzoic acid 1 mg Vitamin B 12 0.01 mg Distilled water 1 L ****Trace elements solution Nitrilotriacetic acid (NTA) 12.8 g FeCl 3 ·6H 2 O 1.35 g MnCl 2 ·4H 2 O 0.1 g CoCl 2 ·6H 2 O 0.024 g CaCl 2 ·2H 2 O 0.1 g ZnCl 2 0.1 g CuCl 2 ·2H 2 O 0.025 g H 3 BO 3 0.01 g Na 2 MoO 4 ·2H 2 O 0.024 g NaCl 1 g NiCl 2 ·6H 2 O 0.12 g Na 2 SeO 4 0.004 g Na 2 WO 4 0.004 g Distilled water 1 L First dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with NaOH, and then add minerals. Final pH 7.0. *****FeS slurry solution Mix 0.5 M FeSO 4 ·7H 2 O and 0.5 M Na 2 S·9H 2 O solutions, wash with pure water several times, finally resuspend the FeS precipitate as 20% solution and autoclave (110°C, 30 min) under a N 2 atmosphere. scientific_assessment: The source formulations and NTA/NaOH pH instruction are identical; separate local owner proposals duplicate the same stock formulation. This does not equate receiving-medium sterilization, final medium pH or doses. NBRC1308 uses1ml and autoclaves with base underN2/CO2(80/20); NBRC1356 uses10ml filter-sterile stock andN2 handling. Listed1L distilled water is an input, not an explicit final-volume make-up. NaOH amount/strength and any finalpH7 readjustment reagent remain unquantified. No global generic starred alias or exact child chemical identity is justified.
